findings.remediation: Grant write scopes only to the job that needs them and keep all other scopes read-only or none.
findings.impact: A compromised workflow step can modify repository content, packages, deployments, checks, or security records within the granted scope.
findings.attack_vector: A permissions block grants a named write scope; exploitability depends on whether untrusted code reaches that job.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: references 9 action or reusable workflow ref(s) that are not pinned to a full commit SHA
findings.remediation: Pin third-party actions and reusable workflows to a full 40-character commit SHA.
findings.impact: Mutable action refs can change without a workflow diff if the upstream tag or branch is moved.
findings.attack_vector: A workflow uses @main, @master, a version tag, or another ref instead of a full commit SHA.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.remediation: Use persist-credentials: false when checking out external/untrusted repositories.
findings.impact: An untrusted checkout can read a persisted GITHUB_TOKEN from Git configuration and reuse its repository privileges.
findings.attack_vector: actions/checkout selects an external or event-controlled revision while persist-credentials remains enabled.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.remediation: Require explicit user approval and use a fixed allowlisted command with bounded arguments.
findings.downgrade: Downgraded from high: no system-impact pattern matched near the call site.
findings.impact: Attackers can execute arbitrary OS commands on the host, leading to full system compromise.
findings.attack_vector: Plugin spawns a child process with attacker-controlled arguments; no user approval gate.
findings.risk_adjustment: Explicit risk (medium) set by caller; evidence-based risk adjustment skipped.
